posting.title: Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context
posting.content:
Build context engineering systems and AI agents on the Elastic platform. Develop production software for retrieval, evaluation, and orchestration, working with engineering partners on reliable distributed services.

Requirements

  • Experience delivering AI systems and strong software engineering skills.
  • Knowledge of search, retrieval, and distributed systems.
